🍤 TEMPURA TCG
JAPAN-EXCLUSIVE PROMOTIONAL CARDS · CARDS WITH IDENTICAL ENGLISH PRINTS HAVE BEEN EXCLUDED
This catalog covers only cards that are exclusive to the Japanese version of the One Piece Card Game. Cards that have an identical print in the English version (PRB-01 reprints, Live Action Edition, 25th Anniversary Edition, Anime 25th Collection EB-02, etc.) have been deliberately excluded.
Showing 188 of 188 entries 🍤 Tempura TCG · Discord-shareable
📋 Note on Reference Links: Every entry links to the official Bandai cardlist or product page where you can view the actual card design. We never link to price-display sites — this is a sales reference for our international Discord community, not a price tracker.
